quote: "The physical cause of the loss of Columbia and its crew was a breach in the Thermal Protection System on the leading edge of the left wing, caused by a piece of insulating foam..."
note: Initiating physical event during launch.

quote: "The organizational causes of this accident are rooted in the Space Shuttle Program's history and culture..."
note: NASA's culture allowed safety traits to degrade over time.

quote: "...an explanation of the intense pressure the program was under to stay on schedule, driven largely by the self-imposed requirement to complete the International Space Station."
note: Self-imposed pressures frequently overrode safety checks.

quote: "The Board concludes that NASA's current organization does not provide effective checks and balances, does not have an independant safety program..."
note: Highlighted ineffective communication and safety oversight.

quote: "X-rays of the Engineering Design Unit clearly showed the G-switches to be installed in the opposite direction they should have been..."
note: SRC failed to deploy the drogue parachute.

quote: "The JPL Development Project Manager did not implement a penetrating systems engineering process and chose not to assign individual JPL responsibility..."
note: Lack of rigorous oversight from JPL management.

quote: "The project, however, did not truly understand that the heritage was broken and, consequently, more careful oversight was needed."
note: Unverified and blind reliance on the Stardust heritage design.

quote: "The project during development and integration did not develop a comprehensive Test As You Fly exceptions list."
note: The centrifuge test was omitted without proper review or mitigation.

quote: "Due to an omission in the modified predefined command sequence actually used, the onboard software function that activates the gyro needed by ESR was not enabled."
note: Removed safe mode functionality prior to the emergency.

quote: "A rapid decision was made that Gyro B was faulty because its output disagreed with the rate indicated by Gyro A. This decision led to the commanding off of Gyro B."
note: Disabled the final safety net, leading to the unrecoverable spin.

quote: "The procedure modifications appear to have not been adequately controlled by ATSC configuration board, properly documented, nor reviewed and approved by ESA and/or NASA."
note: Modifications to procedures were not properly vetted.

quote: "It appeared that the FOT's overly aggressive operations plan... was primarily driven by DSN scheduling and science planning."
note: Led to rushed decisions and missed telemetry checks during the incident.

quote: "The root cause of the WIRE mission loss is a digital logic design error in the instrument pyro electronics box. The transient performance of components was not adequately accounted for in its design."
note: Caused inadvertent pyrotechnic firing upon startup.

quote: "However, the start-up time of the Vectron crystal clock oscillator was not taken into consideration, leaving the circuit in a non-deterministic state..."
note: Allowed the telescope cover to eject prematurely.

quote: "The pyro electronics box design was not peer reviewed, and other system reviews conducted by the instrument design organization did not focus on the electronics box."
note: Review would have likely caught the startup flow flaw.

quote: "The box-level testing used the turn-on of a laboratory power supply instead of the closure of a relay to power the pyro box."
note: Slow rise time of the lab supply masked the failure mechanism during tests.

quote: The propulsion system lacked enveloping, mission-representative testing, and NASA accepted insufficient verification data in lieu of qualification
note: Led directly to in-flight discovery of hardware flaws.

quote: Teflon poppet extrusion within the thruster valve causing an obstruction in oxidizer flow
note: Resulted in temporary loss of 6DOF control during docking.

quote: the most probable proximate cause was the material of the seals within the Starliner helium manifold being incompatible with NTO...
note: Allowed Helium to leak across seven of eight manifolds during flight.

quote: Acceptance of unexplained anomalies (UAs) without root cause resolution allowed systemic issues to persist from OFT1 and OFT2 into CFT.
note: Recurring anomalies were dismissed without uncovering actual root causes.
